description: The file is an entry server module for a Remix-based web application. It handles HTTP requests, manages server-side rendering with streaming, and distinguishes between bot and browser clients to serve appropriate responses.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that sets CORS headers, manages OPTIONS requests, and delegates to bot or browser request handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot requests using streaming and manages response piping.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser requests, similar to handleBotRequest, but optimized for browsers.
